name: Painterly PoC (scratch)
description: Scratch proof of concept for spec/painterly.md P1: a loaded flat petal pull built from today's features only (lanes, hueShift/val per lane, lift-off tail). Not a shipped pack.
author: HereLiesAz

step: if (index <= 1) { dx = cos(heading); dy = sin(heading); } else {
dx = lerp(dx, cos(heading), 0.35); dy = lerp(dy, sin(heading), 0.35);
let nx = dl > 0.001 ? dx / dl : cos(heading);
let ny = dl > 0.001 ? dy / dl : sin(heading);
emit { x: px - ny * u * wspan, y: py + nx * u * wspan, size: len, tip: clamp(cw * 1.15 / len, 0.05, 1), angle: ang,
let bx = px + nx * reach * f;
let by = py + ny * reach * f;
emit { x: bx, y: by, size: reach / 10 * 2.2, tip: clamp(sz / (reach / 10 * 2.2), 0.05, 1), angle: ang, alpha: baseAlpha * load * 1.5, val: 0.9, sat: 1.01 };
emit { x: bx - ny * w * 0.4, y: by + nx * w * 0.4, size: reach / 10 * 2.2, tip: clamp(sz * 0.7 / (reach / 10 * 2.2), 0.05, 1), angle: ang, alpha: baseAlpha * load, val: 0.68, sat: 1.01 };
emit { x: bx + ny * w * 0.4, y: by - nx * w * 0.4, size: reach / 10 * 2.2, tip: clamp(sz * 0.7 / (reach / 10 * 2.2), 0.05, 1), angle: ang, alpha: baseAlpha * load, val: 0.68, sat: 1.01 };
